annotations.title: TIA — IO systems of the project

description: Lists every IO system of the project: {name, number, subnet, controller {device, interface} or null, devices [{device, interface}]}, plus `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] (reads that failed during the scan; empty when all succeeded, otherwise the list may be incomplete; a gap of kind `io_system_subnet` also carries `ioSystem` {number, controller}, the identity the serve decides on, while `subject` is only the name). Requires a connected project. Maps to GET /iosystems. Read-only (class R).
name: tia_io_systems
